Detailed Description

action-contexts for context-menu ("right click") actions

Enumeration Type Documentation

enum action_flags
 

context for an action selected from the context-menu.

this is interesting mostly when the action is to be applied to a seletion of several objects.

Enumerator:
AF_NONE  no flags
AF_YES_TO_ALL  "yes to all", stop asking
AF_CANCEL_ALL  "no to all", stop asking
AF_SELECTION  selection set on action-context (multiple files)
AF_MENUDONE  terminate menu-loop
AF_LAST  last item to process, free any resources.

plugins using this should check this last thing before returning (specifically, after any calls to form_yes_no_all())
